content: ACP v1 spec surface verified: session/update variants are user_message_chunk|agent_thought_chunk|agent_message_chunk|tool_call|tool_call_update|plan|available_commands_update|current_mode_update. tool_call carries toolCallId/title/kind(read|edit|delete|move|search|execute|think|fetch|other)/status(pending|in_progress|completed|failed)/content/locations/rawInput/rawOutput; tool_call_update sends only changed fields. session/request_permission is an agent-to-client REQUEST carrying sessionId + toolCall (a ToolCallUpdate, typically just the id) + options[] each {optionId,name,kind:allow_once|allow_always|reject_once|reject_always}; client replies outcome selected(optionId) or cancelled; the call stays pending while awaiting. Session lifecycle: session/load (needs loadSession cap; params sessionId,cwd,mcpServers), session/resume (sessionCapabilities.resume), session/list (cursor,cwd filter -> sessions[]+nextCursor), session/close (cancel then free), session/delete; configOptions ride ClientCapabilities.session.configOptions at initialize, values returned in new/load/resume responses, mutated via session/set_config_option {configId,sessionId,value} returning full set. Elicitation = elicitation/create agent-to-client request with union variants form(requestedSchema)|url|other; response accept(content)/decline/cancel; elicitation/complete notification follows.
